title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Garden Auditorium on 1966-07-29

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of an early ’66 Dead show with mind‑bending music, even though the exact setlist is uncertain.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear, pristine sound that lets listeners hear the raw, exploratory energy of the Summer of Love era. Reviewers rave about the “mind‑bending” performance and consider it an essential early‑Dead document, despite some confusion over which of two possible setlists belongs to this date.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (average 4.7 stars) and comment on excellent soundboard quality plus a historically significant, compelling performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers describe the audio as "great quality", "pristine" and "crisp", indicating a clean, well‑balanced soundboard capture with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The setlist is ambiguous – reviewers note uncertainty between two possible July 30, 1966 lists – but the early Dead energy and improvisational spirit are highlighted as compelling.
